explanation.1_corridorStandoffDefault: C-1 audited default: layout.footwallStandoff None now resolves to footwall_access_offset + RAMP_CORRIDOR_MARGIN_WIDTHS (6) x tunnel_width (20 -> 50 m; half-spans 1w + rock pillar 2w + turnout-taper allowance 3w, all spatial terms). Every family's plan geometry moves, so cheap counts, statuses, shortlists, junction/entry positions and scores move in all 7 cases; feasibleCount rises (6 -> 12 TABULAR/CUT_AND_FILL/GEOMETRY-STRESS, 5 -> 10 WARPED-301, 6 -> 10 IRREGULAR) because the corridor left the level-development plane.
explanation.2_basisRename: C-3: clearanceBasis CONSERVATIVE -> COARSE_CONSERVATIVE (stage 2-3); stage-4 candidates with a refined window report REFINED_CONSERVATIVE with the actual latticeSpacing / errorBound / window diagnostics.
explanation.3_refinement: C-2: WARPED-301 winner bound 10.771 -> 5.386 m (REFINED_CONSERVATIVE), anchor stand-off 22.36 -> 20.0 m.
explanation.4_winnerChanges: All four winner changes are legitimate re-rankings under the moved corridor with unchanged weights - in every case the new winner's total is lower and the old winner remains FEASIBLE (or loses on the same scores): CUT_AND_FILL: SWITCHBACK-k2-p+0-CCW-g0.120 (total None, NOT_VALIDATED) -> SPIRAL-n1-CCW-e+45-g0.120 (total 2.713755); GEOMETRY-STRESS: SPIRAL-n1-CW-e+0-g0.100 (total None, INFEASIBLE) -> SPIRAL-n1-CW-e+45-g0.100 (total 2.87036); IRREGULAR-REACH-EXCEEDED: SPIRAL-n1-CCW-e+0-g0.120 (total 5.36403, FEASIBLE) -> SPIRAL-n1-CW-e-45-g0.100 (total 4.549262); TABULAR-REFERENCE: SWITCHBACK-k2-p+0-CCW-g0.120 (total None, NOT_VALIDATED) -> SPIRAL-n1-CCW-e+45-g0.120 (total 2.713755); WARPED_VEIN-301: SPIRAL-n1-CCW-e+0-g0.120 (total 3.556699, FEASIBLE) -> SPIRAL-n1-CW-e-45-g0.120 (total 3.206867)
explanation.5_acceptance: WARPED-301 and IRREGULAR-REACH-EXCEEDED stay SUCCESS; WARPED-307 stays NO_FEASIBLE_CANDIDATE for PROVEN geometric reasons (refined-certified main-ramp clearance 1.2-6.2 m vs required 10.59 m; the only clearing ramps fail every level access on OREBODY_CLEARANCE / GRADE_LIMIT). ACCESS-INFEASIBLE stays 0 feasible by design.
explanation.6_knownLimitationForB: excavationSeparation (fixed 15 m taper exclusion, commit O definition) still reads ~0 on helix winners: a branch leaving tangentially from a curving winding diverges only quadratically (~s^2/2 x relative curvature), so the pillar develops beyond 15 m of arc. Commit B replaces the exclusion with the geometry-derived taper s* and gates on it; deliberately NOT patched here.
